metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Tight Glutes FOR GOOD
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to get quick and long-lasting relief for tight, achy glutes.

A common cause of painful glutes (aka buttocks or butt) is because of tightness and weakness that builds over time, causing inflammation and strain. This may lead to pain in the lower back, hips, and thighs. 

To make getting relief easy, we're going to lengthen and strengthen these muscles in a very easy to follow step-by-step guide.

All of these exercises can be done at home, and may give gluteal muscle pain relief within 30 seconds.

Watch now and relieve tight, painful glutes at home!
